summary: Reviewed integration and resolved both independent findings plus a pre-existing delayed slash-focus race exposed by the expanded keyboard flow.

resolved.finding: Inspector peer/parent focus lost across keyed detail loads.
resolved.evidence: browser-focus-reproduction.log failed; browser-final-focus.log repeated navigation passes.
resolved.correction: Workspace/node-bound focus request restores the equivalent enabled control or selected path while leaving draft/query keys unchanged.

resolved.finding: Null-relatedTarget blur allowed later assessment refresh to restore stale navigation focus.
resolved.evidence: browser-blur-reproduction.log failed after plain-text click and live assessment refresh; final regression passes.
resolved.correction: Cancel request on null/non-Node blur target and focus outside navigation.

resolved.finding: Search could restore stale route selection.
resolved.evidence: Earlier focused lane failed; final search, deep-link, canvas and phone keyboard cases pass.
resolved.correction: Compose route writes from the current address bar and skip stale route effects, retaining immediate scene selection.

resolved.finding: Slash queued focus even for mounted inputs, which could displace later Tab focus.
resolved.evidence: browser-final-affected.log retained correct URL/selection but focus returned to the filter; final fast-input and closed-outline cases pass.
resolved.correction: Focus mounted inputs immediately; defer only while opening and only while original surface still owns focus.

limitations: Lead adjudication is not an additional independent review.
Independent reports remain preserved with their original findings.
